{{Quote|Our ex-friend Cie Vos has decided to liberate a case of rations from our stock. Punish him and bring the rations to me.|[[Kavas Urdano]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
'''Cie Vos''' was [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] criminal who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Valarian sells POISON to her patrons! I stole this to prove it to the authorities! Please don't shoot me!|Cie Vos, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KU" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Cie Vos worked for [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|criminal syndicate]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

[[File:ToxicRations.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The toxic rations stolen by Cie Vos]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Vos discovered that Lady Valarian was for some reason poisoning some of the patrons of the ''[[Lucky Despot]]''. The man therefore stole a box of toxic [[Ration pack/Legends|rations]] to prove his point. Declared an enemy of the syndicate, Valarian's lieutenant [[Kavas Urdano]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with [[Death/Legends|killing]] Vos and retrieving the stolen rations. When the spacer approached Vos, outside the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. he insisted that the rations were [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]], and that he wanted to bring the rations as proof to the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|authorities]]. Although he begged not to be killed, the spacer did so anyway, along with two fellow thugs who were defending him. The spacer returned the toxic rations to Urdano, who awarded the spacer with 2,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:CieVosFemale.png|thumb|rigt|150px|Human female depiction of Cie Vos, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Cie Vos was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]]'' [[Star Wars Galaxies]], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:KU" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Cie Vos was present in the original release of the game, being part of [[W:c:swg:Valarian Theme Park (pre-NGE)|Lady Valarian's Quest Series]].<ref name="SWG:KU" />

Because Cie Vos spawned under the generic "jabba_thief" template, his appearance was randomized under one of two possible depictions. He could either appear as a male Zabrak or as a [[Human/Legends|Human]] female. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Vos as male, this article assumes that the male Zabrak depiction is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="SWG:KU" />

With the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 23 Notes for 31 August 2005|Publish 23]]" on [[August 31]], [[2005]], Lady Valarian's Quest Series was deactivated and Cie Vos was consequently removed from the game.<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=swgpatchnotes&message.id=770|text=Update Notes: Publish 23}}</ref>
